qwen3.8-27b._note: challenger 2026-08-18, BEATEN — 23/28 (82.1%) vs qwen3.6's 91/92 (98.9%), and ~3.5x slower. h3_lru_ttl_cache and h7_spec_gauntlet fail in BOTH hard sweeps, h7 at 0/10 rubric points twice. DENSE 27B, not an MoE — the 3.8 line has no mid-size MoE, it jumps 27B -> 2.4T-A95B, so this is NOT a like-for-like successor to qwen3.6-35b-a3b. CAVEAT: 4-bit build (only one Matt owns) vs qwen3.6's 8-bit, so the loss is not purely architectural. Full writeup: writeups/qwen38_vs_qwen36.md

qwen3.8-27b-8bit._note: SETTLED 2026-08-18 — NOT less capable, just 16.9x slower. At an equal generous budget (AGENT_MAX_TOKENS=8000, AGENT_MAX_STEPS=40) BOTH this and qwen3.6-35b score a perfect 8/8 hard; qwen3.6 does it in 122.3s, this takes 2065.3s. Its earlier 89.3% under the suite's 3000-token discipline was the cap truncating a <think>-block reasoning model, NOT a capability gap: h3 needed 613s and h7 needed 754s, then both passed. Keep qwen3.6 as the daily driver; this earns no launcher. Full writeup: writeups/qwen38_vs_qwen36.md
